headword: {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}

definitions.explanation: Activities conducted outside of one's primary company or workplace, such as volunteer work, professional associations, side projects, networking events, or community involvement.

examples.japanese: {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}も{評価|ひょうか}の{対象|たいしょう}になる。
examples.english: Outside-company activities are also subject to evaluation.

examples.japanese: {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}を{通|つう}じて、{異|こと}なる{業界|ぎょうかい}の{人|ひと}と{知|し}り{合|あ}えた。
examples.english: Through outside-company activities, I was able to meet people from different industries.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}を{奨励|しょうれい}する{企業|きぎょう}が{増|ふ}えてきている。
examples.english: Recently, more companies are encouraging their employees to engage in activities outside of work.

notes:
Composed of {社外|しゃがい} (outside the company) and {活動|かつどう} (activities). Reflects the evolving Japanese work culture where employees are increasingly encouraged to develop skills and connections beyond their employer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}に{参加|さんか}する: to participate in outside-company activities
- {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}を{奨励|しょうれい}する: to encourage outside activities
- {社外活動|しゃがいかつどう}の{報告|ほうこく}: report on external activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {課外活動|かがいかつどう}: extracurricular activities — used in school contexts
- {社内活動|しゃないかつどう}: in-company activities — the opposite
- {副業|ふくぎょう}: side job — a specific type of outside activity
